import java.io.PrintWriter
import java.util.*

fun main(args: Array<String>) {
    val inputStream = System.`in`
    val outputStream = System.out
    val `in` = Scanner(inputStream)
    val out = PrintWriter(outputStream)
    solve(`in`, out)
    out.close()
}

private fun solve(scanner: Scanner, out: PrintWriter) {
    val n = scanner.nextBigInteger()
    val m = scanner.nextBigInteger()
    val z = scanner.nextInt()

    val gcd = n.gcd(m)
    val x = n * m / gcd

    out.println(z / x.toInt())
}

fun berlandFootballMinMaxCards(
    numPlayers1: Int,
    numPlayers2: Int,
    numCards1: Int,
    numCards2: Int,
    numCardsShown: Int
): Pair<Int, Int> {
    var amax = numPlayers1
    var kmax = numCards1
    var amin = numPlayers2
    var kmin = numCards2

    // Swap if needed.
    if (kmax < kmin) {
        amax = numPlayers2
        kmax = numCards2
        amin = numPlayers1
        kmin = numCards1
    }

    val min = max(numCardsShown - ((kmin - 1) * amin + (kmax - 1) * amax), 0)

    val rem = max(numCardsShown - amin * kmin, 0)

    val max = if (rem > 0) {
        amin + rem / kmax
    } else numCardsShown / kmin

    return Pair(min, max)
}

fun solve(input: BufferedReader, output: PrintStream) {
    val (x0, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2) = input.readLine().split(' ').map { it.l }

    output.println(
        if (isGood(x0, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2)) "RIGHT"
        else if (
            isGood(x0 - 1, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2) ||
            isGood(x0 + 1, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2) ||
            isGood(x0, y0 - 1, x1, y1, x2, y2) ||
            isGood(x0, y0 + 1, x1, y1, x2, y2) ||

            isGood(x0, y0, x1 - 1, y1, x2, y2) ||

            isGood(x0, y0, x1, y1 - 1, x2, y2) ||
            isGood(x0, y0, x1, y1 + 1, x2, y2) ||

            isGood(x0, y0, x1, y1, x2 - 1, y2) ||
            isGood(x0, y0, x1, y1, x2 + 1, y2) ||
            isGood(x0, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2 - 1) ||
            isGood(x0, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2 + 1)
        ) "ALMOST"
        else "NEITHER"
    )
}

fun l(x0: Long, y0: Long, x1: Long, y1: Long) = (x1 - x0) * (x1 - x0) + (y1 - y0) * (y1 - y0)
fun isGood(x0: Long, y0: Long, x1: Long, y1: Long, x2: Long, y2: Long) = isGood(l(x0, y0, x1, y1), l(x0, y0, x2, y2), l(x1, y1, x2, y2))
fun isGood(a: Long, b: Long, c: Long) =
    if (a == 0L || b == 0L || c == 0L)
        false
    else if (a > b && a > c)
        a - b - c == 0L
    else if (b > a && b > c)
        b - a - c == 0L
    else
        c - a - b == 0L
